name: Horsetail milkweed
desc: Horsetail milkweed (Asclepias subverticillata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias subverticillata is a plant found in the southwestern United States and Mexico. Common names include horsetail milkweed, poison milkweed and whorled milkweed.
